description: This file is part of the Gomega testing framework, specifically the 'format' package responsible for pretty-printing objects, generating diff messages, and handling custom formatters for test output.

classes.name: GomegaStringer
classes.description: Interface for custom object formatting in Gomega, with method GomegaString()

methods.name: RegisterCustomFormatter
methods.description: Registers a custom formatter for object rendering in Gomega output

methods.name: UnregisterCustomFormatter
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered custom formatter

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Generates a formatted success/failure message for matchers

methods.name: MessageWithDiff
methods.description: Generates a diff message highlighting string mismatches

methods.name: Object
methods.description: Pretty-prints an object with indentation, handling nested structures

methods.name: IndentString
methods.description: Indents each line of a string by a specified amount
